blocks.text: The vision’s gold lampstand, bowl, lamps, olive trees, and flowing oil form a picture of continuing provision. Its final image—the two anointed ones standing beside the Lord of the whole earth—places leadership within that provision. The oracle addressed to Zerubbabel gives the vision’s central emphasis: the work before him will not be completed through human might or power, but through Jehovah’s Spirit. The promise that the hands which laid the foundation will also finish the house connects this sustained provision with the task of completion.

sections.title: The lampstand and the two anointed ones
